About The Leather


Handcrafted from full-grain leather in our Heritage Brown oiled finish, this leather combines timeless appearance with exceptional durability — making it ideal for corporate gifts designed to be used long after the moment they are given.

Full-grain leather is the very top layer of the hide, where the fibres are at their tightest and most resilient. Keeping this top layer intact preserves the leather’s natural grain and exceptional durability, making full-grain the strongest form of leather available.

Rather than sanding, correcting, or painting the surface to conceal natural markings, we honour them. These subtle variations are part of what makes full-grain leather so distinctive. It is leather as it has been crafted and valued for thousands of years — resilient, reliable, and made to age beautifully.

For our Heritage Brown edition, we apply a light waxed and oiled finish that enhances the leather’s depth and smoothness. This treatment creates a refined satin feel while allowing the natural grain to remain visible. Over time, the leather develops a rich patina unique to every piece.

All hides are responsibly sourced as a by-product of local farming.

How Will My Logo/Design Look?

Your design is precision laser engraved directly into the leather, not printed. This creates a permanent, refined finish that becomes part of the material itself.

[_**See an example engraving preview.**_](https://mahileather.com/cdn/shop/files/Laser_Logo_Embroidery.png?v=1767968803 "https://mahileather.com/cdn/shop/files/Laser_Logo_Embroidery.png?v=1767968803")

The engraving is high-resolution, allowing it to accurately reproduce logos, text, illustrations, and detailed designs with crisp, clean edges. Visually, the result is a subtle, tone-on-tone finish that looks understated and premium.

Because the design is engraved into the leather, it won’t peel, fade, or wear off, and will age naturally alongside the leather over time.

**We Design It For You**

Recommended for businesses and larger orders. You’ll work with a dedicated point of contact who will help bring your idea to life, providing pre-production previews before anything is made. This option also allows for preferential pricing on volume or repeat orders, as well as gift-ready packaging and personalised gift notes if required. [Click here to get started.](https://mahileather.com/pages/corporate-design-service "https://mahileather.com/pages/corporate-design-service")

## High Definition Leather

We use industry-leading laser engraving technology to permanently integrate your logo or brand mark into the surface of our leather. Penetrating the natural grain itself rather than sitting on top.

The result is an **ultra-fine, high-resolution finish (exceeding 300 DPI)** that becomes part of the material itself—exceptionally sharp, flawlessly consistent, and crafted to endure for a lifetime.

## Gift Ready

Every MAHI piece arrives in a branded cotton dust cover, with a tag explaining our responsible approach to production, leather sourcing, and the contribution each order makes to our partner charity.

High-quality printed gift notes are available for corporate and larger orders.

## Frequently Asked Questions

- ### How does the order process work?






**1\. Choose your order method**

Customize your bag online using the **CUSTOMIZE** button, or [click here to request expert assistance](https://mahileather.com/pages/corporate-design-service "https://mahileather.com/pages/corporate-design-service") (recommended for corporate and large orders).



**2\. Preview**

Online customization gives you an instant preview. If you request assistance, your dedicated account manager will provide a visualization within one business day.



**3\. Craft**

Our artisans handcraft each piece using century-old techniques. Your design is laser-engraved directly onto the leather for a sharp, permanent finish.



**4\. Deliver**

We ship worldwide—either in bulk or directly to recipients. All orders are fully tracked and insured, with delivery typically within five business days.

- ### What are the lead times?






**40 units or fewer:** Typically delivered within 5–10 business days.



**Orders of 100+ units:** May require additional production time. A confirmed delivery timeline will be provided once your requirements are finalized.

- ### Do you offer volume discounts?






We offer competitive bulk discounts depending on the quantity and complexity of your requirements.

- ### Can the MAHI branding be removed?






Yes. Our solution is entirely bespoke, tailored precisely to your requirements.

- ### Do you offer gift wrap and gift notes?






Every MAHI arrives in a gift-ready cotton dust cover. We can also design a bespoke gift note, printed on high-quality card, to accompany your package—perfect for shipping directly to your recipients.

- ### What if I'm not happy with my order?






Every MAHI is covered by a one year warranty and instant replacement guarantee.
